$sources: IS 1343:1980 Clauses 18-22: prestressed concrete (alpha 9 track C12): losses, the stress limits at transfer and in service by type (tension limits as stresses)

prestress.note: IS 1343 gives the tension limits as stresses (tensionForm 'absolute'). Type 1 members (no tension) and Type 2 (tension up to 3 MPa, no visible cracking) are taken together as Class U with 3 MPa; Type 3 (cracked) as Class C with the crack-control spacing of the default pack. Flexural strength, unbonded fps, punching, bonded reinforcement, integrity and anchorage zones are the default pack's (ACI 318 based) rules, named after it. Two-way slabs: IS 1343 has no slab class; the Type 2 limit is used (SAEngine practice).

sources.modulus: IS 456:2000 6.2.3.1 (Ec = 5000 √fck, fck the characteristic cube strength: the project's concrete fc is read as fck under this pack); the other values of the table are BNBC 2020's (the parent pack)
sources.prestress: IS 1343:1980: jacking at most 0.76 fpu (18.5.1); at transfer compression 0.54 fci (post-tensioned, 22.8.1, Figure 8 at M30-M40), tension 1 MPa (22.8.2); in service compression 0.41 fck in bending (22.7.1, Figure 7) and 0.33 fck under the sustained load, tension 3 MPa for Type 2 members; losses by Table 4 (relaxation 0, 35, 70, 90 MPa at 0.5-0.8 fpu), creep coefficients 2.2, 1.6, 1.1 at 7, 28, 365 days (5.2.5.1), shrinkage 0.0003 pre-tensioned and 0.0002 / log10(t + 2) post-tensioned (5.2.4.1); the rest of the prestress rules are the default pack's (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 9)
